summary_en: Completion of simplified stock exchange (簡易株式交換) whereby abc Co. acquired 100% of Bond Co. (amusement bar operator, Tokyo). Stock exchange effective 2026-06-12. No shareholder objections filed during statutory objection period (2026-05-23 onwards). Bond Co. capital 1 million yen. Consolidated earnings impact under review.
title_en: Notice regarding completion of full subsidiary status of Bond Co. Ltd. through simplified stock exchange (progress disclosure)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-12, abc Co. completed a simplified stock exchange (簡易株式交換) making Bond Co. a 100% subsidiary. The stock exchange contract was approved by Bond Co.'s extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 2026-05-21 and was concluded the same date. As the surviving parent company (完全親会社), abc followed the streamlined procedure under Companies Act Article 796(2), publishing statutory notice on 2026-05-23 via electronic public notice (電子公告). No shareholder objections were filed during the statutory objection period. Bond Co. operates amusement bars and is based in Tokyo's Shinbashi district with capital of 1 million yen. The consolidated earnings impact of the transaction is under review and will be disclosed separately as needed.
